name: GE Vernova
description: GE Vernova builds and services the machines that generate and move electricity. Power (gas, nuclear, hydro and steam) is about half of sales and nearly all of the profit: gas turbines are sold on multi-year slot-reservation and order backlogs, then serviced for decades under long-term service agreements, so services are two thirds of Power revenue. Wind (mostly onshore turbines, plus offshore and blades) lost money in 2025 and is being run for break-even. Electrification (grid equipment, power conversion, storage and software) is the fastest-growing line, with transformers coming in-house after the Prolec GE acquisition on 2026-02-02. The installed base generates about 25 percent of the world's electricity, and remaining performance obligations (backlog) were about $150 billion at year-end 2025.

employees.note: Approximately 75,000 employees: about 24,000 Europe, 21,000 US, 19,000 Asia, 6,000 Latin America (10-K human capital section).

businessLines.name: Power
businessLines.how: Sells gas turbines and steam, nuclear and hydro equipment to utilities and industrial customers (slot-reservation deposits and orders), then earns recurring service revenue from long-term service agreements on the installed base; services were 66 percent of segment revenue in 2025 (computed 13,081/19,767). Gas turbine installed base is about 7,000 units, about 1,800 under long-term service agreements.

businessLines.name: Wind
businessLines.how: Sells onshore wind turbines and some offshore turbines and blades to wind-farm developers as one-time projects; services (repowering, upgrades, maintenance) are a small recurring part (20 percent of revenue). Revenue fell 6 percent in 2025, mostly offshore.

businessLines.name: Electrification
businessLines.how: Sells grid equipment (substations, switchgear, protection), power conversion and storage, and grid software to utilities, industrial and renewable customers, mostly as one-time equipment orders with about a quarter in services (computed 2,263/9,642).

brands.name: Gas Power (Heavy-Duty Gas Turbines)
brands.note: Gas turbine orders 173 units in 2025 vs 112 in 2024; revenue $16,006M, 42 percent of total revenues (computed)

brands.name: Prolec GE
brands.note: Remaining 50 percent bought from Xignux, completed 2026-02-02 for approximately $5.3 billion at closing; transformer maker with about 10,000 employees at seven sites, five in the US; was an unconsolidated joint venture before

brands.name: Financial Services
brands.note: Legacy financial business included in Corporate and other

whatsNext.text: Prolec GE full ownership acquisition completed
